Product overview

Margarita glass clips are a low-cost, high-impact promotional item for beach bars, Mexican restaurant chains and beverage brands. Injection-moulded in food-contact ABS and printed with your brand or a sponsored beer and spirits label, they turn every served glass into branded signage.

Margarita Glass Clip - Slanted Version (model PC30Y) is moulded in ABS. It accepts Fits margarita martini glass. Bottle holder clip for slanted margarita glasses. Unit weight is 13 g and it is packed 500 pcs / 52x42x37 cm / 7.5 kg, so you can plan freight per carton rather than per unit.

Because the tooling is ours, motor quality, finish and box counts stay consistent between orders — the single most common complaint buyers raise about sourcing from trading companies. Every run is checked against the approved pre-production sample before it is packed.

This item can be produced in your own colour and decorated with your logo, event name or a client's brand. Retail-ready colour boxes, hang tags and UPC barcodes are available for retail and e-commerce programmes. Add it to a mixed order and we will consolidate it with the rest of your items so it ships as one entry.

How to order this item

Add the Margarita Glass Clip - Slanted Version to your quote list with the quantity you need, or send us the model number directly. We return a quotation that sets out the unit price for your specification, decoration cost, packaging cost and dispatch time, followed by a virtual proof and — where the finish is colour sensitive — a physical pre-production sample for approval. OEM and ODM briefs are welcome: send a drawing, a reference sample or a target cost.

What is the production lead time?

Standard FOB dispatch is 10-15 days for small batch production after sample approval, excluding shipping time to your destination. Peak season and full-container programmes are planned per order — the confirmed date is stated on the quotation and proforma invoice.

Is the material food contact safe?

The Margarita Glass Clip - Slanted Version is moulded in ABS. The food-contact test report and safety data sheet for the recorded material grade are provided with the quotation so your compliance team can file them for your market.

Novelty Drinkware · How MOQ works

Which glasses does the clip fit?

Each clip is moulded for a specific rim profile — the straight version fits 20 oz schooners and 16 oz glasses, the slanted version fits margarita martini glasses. Send your glass specification or a sample rim measurement and we will confirm the fit before production.
